task: OTHRYS TRAINING L2-003. Create exactly training/level-2/L2-003-todo-store/todoStore.mjs. Export createTodoStore(filePath), stdlib only, frozen API {list,get,add,update,toggle,remove}. State is JSON array. Missing => [] and reads never write. Persist atomically via unique same-dir temp+rename. Existing malformed/non-array/invalid todo/duplicate id => Error('STATE_CORRUPT') and mutations never overwrite corrupt state. Canonical todo exactly {id,text,done}; id non-empty string unchanged, text non-empty string trimmed, done boolean default false. add rejects invalid shape/extra keys as INVALID_TODO and duplicate as DUPLICATE_ID. get returns clone or undefined. list preserves insertion order and returns clones. update existing id with non-empty patch containing only text/done; text trimmed non-empty, done boolean; otherwise INVALID_PATCH. toggle existing flips done. remove existing returns clone. update/toggle/remove missing => NOT_FOUND. Returned values cannot mutate persisted state. Deterministic, no network/deps/secrets. Touch no other file.
